hook.name: YieldHook
hook.description: YieldHook is an ERC-20 token (YIELD) and Uniswap v4 hook implementing yield farming: buying into the pool activates a user's stake, selling deactivates it, with token emissions distributed to active stakers. Contains a critical backdoor: an unguarded `setHook(address)` function that permanently locks all sells via division-by-zero once called with the pool token address. Liquidity removal is also permanently disabled.
